instruction.text: Draw a line between the Sun and the Earth to learn the distance between them.

feedback.end: The Sun and the Earth are approximately 150 million kilometres apart. This is much greater than the distance between the Earth and the Moon.

atoms.b: ((++Unlike Like)) the Earth, the Sun is a star. It looks much ((++bigger smaller)) than other stars because it is much closer to us.
Like the Earth and the Moon, the Sun is ((++spherical cylindrical)). It is much bigger than the Earth and the Moon, and is made up of of hot, glowing ((++gas liquid)).
The Sun has a very ((++high low)) temperature. On the surface, the Sun is around <mat>5600°C.</mat> At its ((++core North_Pole)), it is even hotter at <mat>15000000°C.</mat>

instruction.text: Choose the two things the Sun is a major source of for the solar system.

feedback.finish: The heat and light generated by the Sun warms the Earth. This is what allows life to survive here!

instruction.text: Are the following statements true or false?

atoms.a: The Sun is the main source of light for the solar system.
The Sun is the biggest planet in the solar system.

feedback.wrong: The Sun may be the biggest celestial body in the solar system, but it is a star, not a planet!

atoms.a: Like the Earth and the Moon, the Sun is a sphere.
The Sun is made up of different solids and liquids.
